mapper.sql: b.id, b.batch_name, b.academic_term, b.graduation_last, b.mu_min, b.mu_max, b.qualify_pct, b.tier1_pct, b.tier2_pct, b.tier3_pct, b.publicity_days, b.status, b.notice_title, b.notice_url, b.publicity_start, b.publicity_end, b.computed_at, b.created_by, b.created_at, b.updated_at, b.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(c.real_name, ''), c.nickname, c.username) AS created_by_name
FROM rank_batch b LEFT JOIN users c ON c.id = b.created_by

sql.if: AND (b.batch_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.academic_term LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rank_batch (batch_name, academic_term, graduation_last, mu_min, mu_max, qualify_pct, tier1_pct, tier2_pct, tier3_pct, publicity_days, status, notice_title, notice_url, publicity_start, publicity_end, computed_at, created_by, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{batchName}, #{academicTerm}, #{graduationLast}, #{muMin}, #{muMax}, #{qualifyPct}, #{tier1Pct}, #{tier2Pct}, #{tier3Pct}, #{publicityDays}, #{status}, #{noticeTitle}, #{noticeUrl}, #{publicityStart}, #{publicityEnd}, #{computedAt}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE b.deleted = 0
ORDER BY b.academic_term DESC, b.id DESC

SELECT
WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.status != 'draft' AND b.academic_term = #{academicTerm} ORDER BY b.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE rank_batch SET batch_name = #{batch.batchName}, academic_term = #{batch.academicTerm}, graduation_last = #{batch.graduationLast}, mu_min = #{batch.muMin}, mu_max = #{batch.muMax}, qualify_pct = #{batch.qualifyPct}, tier1_pct = #{batch.tier1Pct}, tier2_pct = #{batch.tier2Pct}, tier3_pct = #{batch.tier3Pct}, publicity_days = #{batch.publicityDays}, notice_title = #{batch.noticeTitle}, notice_url = #{batch.noticeUrl}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{batch.id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{fromStatus}

UPDATE rank_batch SET status = 'publicity', publicity_days = #{publicityDays}, publicity_start = #{publicityStart}, publicity_end = #{publicityEnd}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{fromStatus}
